facts.claim: Azamara Onward (Azamara): Entered service 1999; 57,000 GT; 670 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 314 m length; R-Class class.
MS Azamara Onward, formerly R Three and Pacific Princess, is a cruise ship owned and operated by Azamara Cruises since 2022.
On 21 January 2021, Carnival announced the ship had been sold to an unnamed buyer, later revealed to be Azamara Cruises.
